Around [[3643 BBY]], [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] was sent on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to find [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yonlach]] during their [[Hunt for Jaesa Willsaam|search]] for [[Nomen Karr]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="TOR:SA" /> The [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] found Yonlach's location and eliminated him along with his fellow Jedi Master [[Yul-Li]].<ref name="TOR:GitD" />
